scraper.code:
function listPosts({url,$}) {return {posts:$('article header h2 a[href^="/blog/"]').toArray().map(e=>({url:$(e).attr('href'),title:$(e).text().trim()})),next:null};}
function parsePost({url,$}) {const body=$(".markdown").first().clone();body.find('script,style,nav,header,footer,.post-nav,.subscribe-widget,.subscription-widget,.post-bottom').remove();return {title:$("h1").first().text().trim(),bodyHtml:body.html()||'',author:$('meta[name="author"]').attr('content')||null,publishedAt:$('meta[property="article:published_time"]').attr('content')||$('time').first().attr('datetime')||null,tags:[]};}
scraper.notes: 實際檢視首頁、文章列表與文章HTML；正文容器 .markdown。
